Subject: SIG intake: SAML session provenance + SCIM delta samples

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for taking this. We are finishing our SIG questionnaire for an upcoming compliance review and have a couple of follow-up asks specific to access control and identity artifacts. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following artifacts for Helium Health's tenant (tenant-id: hh-prod-01):

- SAML assertion samples (redacted) for successful logins over a 7-day window (include assertion timestamps and NameID format)
- SCIM delta snapshot for user provisioning changes covering the same window (creation, update, delete events)
- A short provenance note that describes how session assertions are recorded and retained (logs/claims, retention TTL)

Our auditor prefers example payloads (JSON/CSV) and a short statement we can attach to the SIG/CAIQ answers. If you can share an expected delivery timeline, that would be great — target is next Thursday but we can be flexible by a few days.

Thanks,
Maya

Maya — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Ben (sales lead) and Laura from Security/Controls who will assemble the artifact bundle. Quick notes:

- We can produce redacted SAML assertion samples scoped to hh-prod-01 and include the NameID/issuer/timestamps.
- SCIM delta exports (CSV) are available from our provisioning pipeline; we will include event type (create/update/delete), actor, and timestamps.

Proposed delivery: initial bundle within 72 hours (by Fri end-of-day) unless you need a longer window. If you need the full 30-day tail for the auditor, say so and we will extend the export range.

I attached a short manifest listing the files we plan to include and a prelim workback. Please confirm the 7-day window (which seven days) and whether you prefer sample assertions in JSONL or as quoted XML.

Thanks — Aditya

Hi Maya — Laura from Security Controls here. Per Aditya/Ben, we prepared the sample artifacts and a short provenance note. Deliverables we are attaching in the bundle:

1) saml_assertion_samples.jsonl — three redacted assertion examples converted to JSON with fields: issuer, subject(NameID format), audience, authnInstant, attributes (redacted), and a comment indicating what was removed.
2) scim-delta-sample.csv — sample rows showing create/update/delete, actor-id (system/service account), timestamp, and resource id.
3) requested_manifest.csv — manifest of all files we will place in the secure share.
4) provenance_note.txt — brief description: how assertions are logged, retention period (90 days for assertion payloads; 365 days for audit indices), where raw logs live (s3://redwood-audit-logs/tenants/hh-prod-01), and the process for redaction prior to customer delivery.

Forwarding the first sample below for immediate reference. If the auditor needs XML verbatim, we can re-export the raw assertion (redacted) and deliver as .xml.
